designationHistory.indexText: Flint Hills National Wildlife Refuge was established as an overlay refuge on Army Corps of Engineers land at John Redmond Reservoir.

authority.citation: Overlay on U.S. Army Corps of Engineers John Redmond Reservoir lands (cooperative agreement)

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
